newsitem.title: USA: Texas Instruments ships 13 mln 56K chipsets.
newsitem.headline: Texas Instruments ships 13 mln 56K chipsets.

text.p: Texas Instruments Inc said Monday it has shipped more than 13 million high-speed modem chipsets used in 56K-class modems.
Texas Instrument's chipsets are found in both PC modems and at Internet service provider installations which use 3Com Corp 's U.S. Robotics-brand platforms.

The chipsets are based on Texas Instruments' digital signal processing chips, which are specialized chips that add and multiply tens of millions of complex formulas per second -- about 10-50 times faster than the traditional microprocessor.
The company said the acceptance for 56K-class products has been strongest in North America, based on worldwide shipments.
